Transform starter kit into Will''s Coffee Shop application

- Rebranded entire application with coffee shop theme and professional styling
- Updated database schema for coffee shop operations (menu_items, customer, order, order_detail)

- Implemented modal-based UI for all create, update, and delete operations
- Added comprehensive seed data with coffee drinks, pastries, customers, and sample orders
- Updated navigation and removed example blueprint
- Changed port to 5030
- Applied coffee-themed color scheme with browns, creams, and warm tones

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Add employee authentication, dashboard, and 7% tax calculation

- Implemented employee login system with session management
- Created auth blueprint with login_required decorator and logout functionality
- Added dashboard with live stats (total sales, customer count, recent orders)
- Integrated login form into index page with two-column layout
- Added employee info modal showing name, username, ID, and role
- Implemented 7% tax calculation on all order totals
- Added footer with contact info and quick links
- Removed About link from logged-in navigation
- Updated navigation to show different menus for logged-in vs logged-out users
- Changed employee name to "Admin User" for willnelson account
